sub.de: Da Brunna host scho gseng? Staubi is er.
sub.en: Have you seen the well? Dusty, it is.

sub.de: Mei Oide sagt, s Brot werd teia.
sub.en: My wife says bread is getting dear.

sub.de: Morgn miass ma fria auf, Hans.
sub.en: Tomorrow we must rise early, Hans.
Greetings, neighbour!

sub.de: Servus, na, ja, du aa do?
sub.en: Hello, well, you here too?
Hello, how are you?

sub.de: Wo is denn da Pfarrer heid?
sub.en: Where is the priest tonight?

sub.de: Kimmst no auf a Bier eina?
sub.en: Coming in for one more beer?
How late is it already?

sub.de: Oiso, oiso, wia ma s nimmt...
sub.en: Well, well, as one takes it...
Mhm... yes, yes, well...
